nodes.label: ADR 0151: GLUE opens in GLUE Home's own window, showing the live site
nodes.rationale: User wanted a desktop app rather than opening another browser. Chose the live site in a native window over a copy bundled into GLUE Home. Window loads the same site and origin, so Home mode and account work unchanged.

nodes.label: Native window showing live site
nodes.rationale: A native window loads the live GLUE site (https://joaopmanso.github.io/glue/?app=window#/) with same origin as browser tab, so Home mode and account work unchanged. Only the site stays in it, other links open in the system.

nodes.label: Window storage separate from browser
nodes.rationale: The window has its own storage: a first sign-in once. Its library comes from GLUE Home (Home mode), as in a tab.

nodes.label: Home mode works in GLUE Home's window
